E-001.statement: The system shall collect system events, authentication activity, process information, and security alerts from multiple departments.

tests.given: A university server department generates system events, authentication logs, process spawns, and security alerts
tests.when: The monitoring platform initiates data collection
tests.then: All event types are captured and stored in the platform's ingestion pipeline
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of collected event streams from server departments

E-002.statement: The platform shall detect unusual login behavior, repeated failed authentication, suspicious process activity, and unauthorized configuration changes.

tests.given: A user attempts multiple failed logins from a new IP address
tests.when: The monitoring platform processes authentication events
tests.then: An alert is generated for unusual login behavior
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the generated alert for repeated failed logins

tests.given: A process spawns with an unknown command-line argument on a managed endpoint
tests.then: An alert is triggered for suspicious process activity
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the generated alert for suspicious process activity

tests.given: A configuration change is made to a system without approval
tests.then: An alert is raised for unauthorized configuration changes
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the generated alert for unauthorized configuration change

E-003.statement: Security administrators should be able to review alerts, investigate affected devices, record investigation notes, change alert status, and isolate compromised endpoints when necessary.

tests.given: An operator accesses the monitoring interface with valid credentials
tests.when: The operator requests to review a security alert
tests.then: The requested alert is returned in full detail
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the alert response

tests.given: An administrator selects an affected device from an alert list
tests.when: The administrator initiates a device investigation
tests.then: The system displays device-level activity logs and current state
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the device investigation interface response

tests.given: An administrator records notes during an investigation
tests.when: The administrator submits a note entry
tests.then: The note is saved and associated with the alert and device
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the note submission and persistence

tests.given: An administrator identifies a compromised endpoint in an alert
tests.then: The endpoint is marked as isolated and its access is restricted
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the isolation action and device state change
